contracts.name: GetPlateCornerForces
contracts.summary: Retrieves a plate-corner packet and projects it into a described managed member basis.
contracts.remarks: Returns nodal Fx/Fy/Fz/Mx/My/Mz in global axes, not plate-center stresses or moments per unit width. The six-slot Double buffer follows installed 2024-2026 VBA examples; global axes follow the main adapter and read-only 2026 equilibrium checks. No extra plate-basis rotation is applied. Native false discards every buffer value. Case family describes metadata only: this native API accepts the numeric case selector and does not activate or disambiguate analysis families itself. Projects global corner forces and moments into a managed member basis at the same corner point. It does not reverse member-end signs, transfer moments, sum adjacent plates or return native analytical-member result forces. Beam overloads use supplied beta degrees and require the corner to match a supplied member end ID and point; node-direction overloads use zero beta and no fabricated native member ID. Projected global Y defines the reference except near vertical, where projected global Z is used. This convention is not native orientation read-back.
